description: TWIN-10 validation cohort — 7 apo/holo paired + 3 frontier apo. All PDB IDs empirically verified via data.rcsb.org/rest/v1/core/entry/{id}.

targets.description: KRAS G12D — SII-P cryptic pocket. Primary checkpoint target.
targets.notes: Published 2024 clinical program. MRTX-1133 is first G12D inhibitor. Switch-II reshapes on binding (induced fit). Rigid-core alignment drops RMSD 7.4→2.1 Å.
Novartis 2024 Nature breakthrough. 180-degree D1/D2 domain rotation on binding. Synthetic lethal with MSI-high.
Syndax revumenib FDA-approved Dec 2024 for NPM1-mut AML. Central cavity relatively pre-formed.
Foghorn clinical program. Near lock-and-key binding; RMSD apo↔holo <0.5Å on Cα.
Repare clinical. CCNE1-amp synthetic lethal. RP-6306 exploits atropisomer rigidity.
Artios clinical. HRD synthetic lethal. Modest apo resolution (3.55Å); verify prep handles gaps.
KSQ-4279 binds in a pocket THAT DOES NOT EXIST in apo — pure induced fit. Heterodimer with UAF1; handle multichain per CLAUDE.md.

targets.description: CBL-B TKBD — blind predict + validate against 8GCY.
targets.failed_run_artifacts: see cblb_apo/ for 3 attempts with escalating flags — all 0 spikes
targets.notes: DEFINITIVE REGIME BOUNDARY. Three runs attempted: (1) baseline flags → 0 spikes; (2) NMA amp=3.0 + filter-otsu + adaptive-bias → 0 spikes (NMA modes have eigenvalues ~1e-6, too floppy to drive firing); (3) REST2 + NMA amp=10 + stepped-holds + filter-otsu + adaptive-bias → still 0 spikes even at REST2 effective T=1000K on stream 7. 394-residue TKBD with aromatics at 89A RoG (vs KRAS 15A) places CBL-B 3VGO outside the engine's neuromorphic detection regime. Skipping in campaign; document as patent honest-disclosure of engine regime boundary. 8GCY validation opportunity deferred pending engine-side physics improvements.

targets.description: TREX1 — cGAS-STING negative regulator. True frontier apo.
targets.notes: Clinically undrugged. No small-molecule allosteric holo in PDB. Any high-confidence cryptic = first-in-class discovery claim.

targets.description: TRIP12 HECT catalytic domain — E3 ubiquitin ligase business end. Drug-design relevant.
targets.notes: Human TRIP12 HECT catalytic domain, 2025 cryo-EM 3.4A (Nat Struct Mol Biol). Published as K29-linked ubiquitin chain intermediate. Ligand SY8 = 5-aminopentanone (C5H11NO) is a K29-isopeptide linkage analog (substrate mimic), NOT a drug — strip for apo. Selected over 9BKS (WWE+ADP, 1.17A) for catalytic-site relevance: drug discovery targets HECT cysteine + allosteric pockets. No published small-molecule inhibitors on TRIP12. Frontier claim: detect cryptic pockets on the catalytic HECT domain.
